name: application-status-application-tracker
title: Status Application Tracker
description: Government/civic application-status tracker: a horizontal numbered-step progress bar (Submitted, Under review, Decision) above a case number, status badge, processing office, and estimated decision date.
useWhen: Tracking the status of a government or civic application (permit, license, benefits) through submitted/under-review/decision stages.
You need to surface a case number, processing office, and estimated decision date alongside progress.

Distinct from Claim Status Tracker, which renders a vertical timeline with a completion date per step for an insurance claim, rather than a horizontal stepper with case metadata for a government application.
avoidWhen: Tracking an insurance claim with per-step completion dates — use Claim Status Tracker instead.
There's no case number or processing-office metadata to show — a plain stepper is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The stepper's connecting lines use flex-1 so segments stretch evenly regardless of container width; the metadata grid collapses gracefully since it's already two columns.
accessibility: The stepper is a semantic ordered list with an aria-label describing its purpose.
Completed vs. upcoming stages are distinguished by both fill color and text weight/color, never color alone.
Status badge text (e.g. "Under review") duplicates the current stage conveyed visually by the stepper, reinforcing state through text.
